explanation: Run a complete Fisher–Yates shuffle: at position i, swap in a uniformly selected remaining entry. Fresh choices on each call make permutations independent. The wrapper retains the native million-sample distribution and sequence checks.
timeComplexity: O(n) per permutation; wrapper sampling is separate
attribution: Original Java implementation and explanation for EPI Practice, based on the displayed public contract and our independently authored C# solution; no upstream reference code adapted.
